Basic Function

Under direction of the Programs Director or assigned supervisor, the Program Manager is responsible for managing assigned program activities associated with maintaining quality academic and student services programs.

Key Position Accountabilities

Oversee Lavender Initiatives, including the Lavender Future Scholars cohort, identity-affirming programming, LGBTQIA+ student support, allyship education, and coordination with faculty and Academic Deans.
Develop and coordinate services for student parents and students with dependent children, including single parents, by strengthening access to childcare information, financial aid, Basic Needs, academic support, and campus and community resources.
Support campus-wide programming and events by collaborating with the Office of Student Life and campus partners on event planning, implementation, student engagement, and inclusive programming.
Provide program leadership and operational oversight by coordinating assigned support staff, managing budgets and contracts, and building partnerships across academic departments, student services, and community organizations.
Advance evidence-informed practice and continuous improvement by staying current with higher education research, emerging trends, and promising practices; assessing participation, student needs, service gaps, and outcomes; and applying findings to strengthen programs and services.

Representative Duties

Manage the implementation of multiple project activities to meet or exceed assigned program(s) expectations.
Manage and monitor budgets to ensure compliance with regulations and/or directives from program agencies and cooperative educational partners.
Assist in preparation and administration of budget, control and authorize expenditures, approve invoices for payment, and respond to budget inquiries from college staff.
Supervise and coordinate department planning and operations; personnel supervision, including development and evaluation of all support staff.
Coordinate the release of project information and outreach activities to familiarize students with the services and programs of the college.
Develop and implement methods to identify and serve students who meet project guidelines, assessing their needs and providing programming to address those needs.
Participate in meetings and conferences related to programs within the assigned area; disseminate information, coordinate projects and implement procedural changes; follow up on action items, and develop program reports as needed.
Market the College and assigned program(s) to the College community and the general public.
Perform related duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree required.
Two years of experience related to area of assignment.
Demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, ethnic, and disability backgrounds of community college students and employees.

Knowledge & Abilities

Knowledge of:

Student services available at the college.
Modern office procedures, methods and computer equipment.
Principles and procedures of financial record-keeping and reporting.
Pertinent federal, state and local laws, codes and regulations related to the assigned special programs processes.
Principles of public speaking.
Record-keeping and report preparation methods.
Principles of providing work direction and guidance to others.
Correct English usage, spelling, grammar and punctuation.

Ability To

Evaluate and implement project goals.
Communicate information to individuals and groups.
Interpret and apply the policies and procedures of the college and the project initiatives.
Interact with and motivate others.
Maintain records and prepare reports.
Prepare and monitor budgets.
Supervise and provide work direction and guidance to assigned staff.
Understand and follow oral and written instructions.
Communicate effectively both orally and in writing.
Establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with others.
Collaborate with college personnel and key project staff to track program effectiveness based on evidenced based milestones for student success.
Develop and facilitate orientations, seminars, and workshops designed to familiarize students, faculty, and staff with assigned special programs opportunities.

jobs.title: LEAD CARE MANAGER (South Bay Coverage)
jobs.description:
BLEHEALTH is seeking qualified candidates who reside within the South Bay service area
and are able to work exclusively within this geographic region
. Candidates must live in or near ZIP codes 90230–90293, 90731–90755, and 90801–90899, and must demonstrate reliable access to the South Bay community for field‑based duties, member visits, provider coordination, and in‑person engagements as required.

Job Description

The Lead Care Manager plays a vital role in supporting chronically ill and high‑risk members by coordinating care, reducing barriers, and improving health outcomes. This position works in continuous partnership with members, families/caregivers, providers, hospitals, and community resources to deliver high‑quality, person‑centered Enhanced Care Management (ECM) services.

Key Responsibilities

Care Coordination & Member Support

Coordinate care across clinics, hospitals, specialists, and community agencies using strong care coordination, case management, and organizational skills to ensure a seamless experience and avoid duplication of services.
Oversee the delivery of ECM services and ensure implementation and follow‑through of individualized care plans, applying project management and prioritization skills.
Provide services where the member lives, seeks care, or feels most comfortable, demonstrating flexibility, cultural awareness, and strong interpersonal skills.
Assess unmet medical, behavioral, and social needs and develop comprehensive care plans using critical thinking, problem‑solving, and clinical judgment.
Support access to medical, behavioral health, and specialty care; arrange transportation and assist with appointment scheduling using effective communication and coordination abilities.
Accompany members to office visits when appropriate, maintaining professional boundaries and member‑centered engagement.
Monitor treatment adherence, including medication compliance, using attention to detail and follow‑through.
Provide health promotion, self‑management coaching, and culturally/linguistically appropriate education using motivational interviewing and trauma‑informed care techniques.
Promote timely access to care, preventive services, and reduced emergency room utilization and hospital readmissions through proactive planning and quality‑improvement practices.

Member Engagement & Health Promotion

Use motivational interviewing, trauma‑informed care, and harm‑reduction approaches to build trust and support behavior change.
Increase member capacity for self‑management and shared decision‑making through clear communication and coaching skills.
Connect members to relevant community resources to improve health, stability, and overall well‑being using resource navigation and problem‑solving abilities.
Apply crisis navigation skills when members present with urgent or complex needs.

Collaboration & Communication

Serve as the primary point of contact, advocate, and informational resource for members, caregivers, providers, payers, and community partners using strong interpersonal and relationship‑building skills.
Maintain strong relationships with primary care and specialty providers, ensuring timely communication and coordination during transitions of care through professional collaboration and follow‑up.
Work closely with hospital staff on discharge planning and follow‑up using effective teamwork and care‑transition management.
Facilitate and attend meetings between members, caregivers, providers, and community partners as needed, demonstrating clear communication and facilitation skills.
Communicate with members through face‑to‑face visits, secure email, phone calls, text messages, and other approved methods using professional communication and documentation skills.
Work independently and collaboratively with diverse teams, applying team‑building, adaptability, and strong organizational skills.

Program Support & Compliance

Identify high‑risk members and ensure they are added to the registry or flagged in the EHR, demonstrating strong data accuracy and attention to detail.
Monitor care plan adherence, evaluate effectiveness, and adjust plans as needed using quality‑improvement principles and analytical skills.
Maintain accurate, timely documentation and meet productivity expectations, including a minimum of 30 schedules per day, supported by effective time‑management and prioritization abilities.
Attend all required ECM trainings, webinars, and meetings, applying continuous learning and change‑management skills to daily practice.
Provide feedback to support ongoing improvement of the ECM program using critical thinking and process‑improvement tools.
Ensure all services are delivered in accordance with Medi‑Cal Managed Care Plan (MCP) guidelines, demonstrating regulatory awareness and compliance discipline.
Use Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and other systems effectively to support documentation, reporting, and communication.
Handle all Protected Health Information (PHI) in full compliance with HIPAA; public or shared spaces may not be used for work at any time.
Follow BLE Health’s password and data‑security protocols, including secure storage, device protection, and regular password updates.
Limit personal tasks and errands to designated break and lunch periods to maintain productivity and workflow integrity.

Qualifications

Required

Valid California driver’s license, active auto insurance, and a clean driving record
Reliable personal vehicle and ability to drive within a 20‑mile radius of your local service area as needed.
Be able to visit hospitals, member homes, and community locations as needed to support field‑based Enhanced Care Management services.
Negative TB test and current CPR certification prior to hire.
Successful completion of a Live Scan fingerprint/background check.
Ability to consistently meet daily productivity expectations.

Preferred

Associate or bachelor’s degree in health science, social services, or a related field.
Experience as a Social Worker, LVN, or in case management.
Familiarity with CalAIM, Enhanced Care Management (ECM), or Medi‑Cal managed care programs.

Immediate Benefits

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Analytics, Automation & Value Discovery
jobs.description:
This isn't a traditional BI or dashboard-development role. VCA is building a new Analytics, Data & Automation capability within Value Protection designed to turn data into measurable business opportunity.

The Senior Program Manager, Analytics, Automation & Value Discovery
serves as the enterprise analytical discovery engine responsible for identifying, quantifying, prioritizing and enabling operational, financial, revenue, margin and performance improvement opportunities across VCA hospitals and support functions. The role connects disparate enterprise data, develops automated monitoring and exception-based reporting, and builds business intelligence and AI-enabled solutions that translate complex information into actionable insights. Working closely with Operations, Finance, Medical Operations, Risk, Revenue Cycle, Procurement, Inventory Management, Pricing, Compliance and Technology, the position improves enterprise visibility, strengthens accountability, reduces financial leakage and supports scalable activation of improvement opportunities.

This role requires associates to work a hybrid schedule out of one of the MVH North America Hub Locations - Vancouver, WA | Santa Monica, CA | Tampa, FL.

Essential Responsibility/Tasks:

Develop and maintain enterprise analytical frameworks that identify revenue opportunities, charge capture gaps, margin leakage, operational inefficiencies, inventory losses, pricing variances and compliance exceptions.
Design, build and maintain automated dashboards, scorecards, Power BI solutions, reporting tools, data models and executive-ready performance views.
Integrate and connect data across practice management, finance, inventory, procurement, payroll, compliance and other enterprise systems.
Create automated exception-monitoring and AI-enabled tools that proactively surface unusual trends, anomalies, financial leakage and emerging business risks.
Partner with Finance, Operations, Medical Operations, Revenue Cycle, Procurement and other functions to evaluate, prioritize, activate and measure opportunities.
Perform deep-dive analyses, root-cause investigations and scenario modeling; translate findings into clear executive recommendations.
Support ancillary revenue growth, charge capture, inventory optimization, pricing integrity, labor productivity and waste-reduction initiatives.
Develop KPI frameworks and benefit-tracking methods to measure adoption, financial impact, operational performance and sustainability.
Maintain data governance, reporting accuracy, documentation, access controls and quality standards for analytical products.
Evaluate emerging AI and automation capabilities and support pilots, enterprise transformation, RRMs and future Center of Excellence initiatives.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE
:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. Preference is for a degree with emphasis in Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering or related discipline.
Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in business intelligence, analytics, automation, finance analytics, consulting, reporting or related fields. Experience in healthcare, veterinary, retail, multi-site operations, or enterprise transformation is preferred.
Power BI, Microsoft, data analytics, automation or project/program management certification is preferred.
Advanced proficiency with Power BI, SQL, Power Automate, Microsoft 365, data modeling and reporting platforms is required. Experience with generative AI, copilots, machine-learning-enabled platforms, Python or cloud data tools is preferred.
English proficiency for executive presentations, technical documentation and cross-functional partnership.
Strong business acumen, communication, stakeholder management, and ability to manage multiple enterprise initiatives is required. Preferred experience includes ability to identify and measure revenue capture, margin improvement or operational performance opportunity.
All degrees will be deemed “or equivalent combination of education and experience” unless absolutely required to do the job (i.e., DVM degree for Veterinarian, Law degree for Attorney, etc.).

PREFERRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

Demonstrated ability to transform fragmented data into practical, actionable business insights.
Advanced analytics, business intelligence, automation, exception monitoring and data visualization capabilities.
Strong knowledge of business operations, financial metrics, process improvement and performance measurement.
Experience using AI-assisted analysis and automation to identify patterns, anomalies and hidden opportunities.
Excellent executive communication, influencing and cross-functional stakeholder management skills.
Strong initiative, curiosity, ownership, judgment and ability to build new capabilities in ambiguous environments.

Business Acumen
Leads Change or Change Management
Financial Acumen
Innovation Management
Problem Solving

Position Title:

Join the team at The Senior Source and feel the energy, enthusiasm, and passion for Making Older Better. We are seeking a Guardianship Benefits Case Manager
with experience working with older adults and that possesses exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.   

Purpose: 

The Guardianship Benefits Case Manager is responsible for coordinating, maintaining, and protecting public benefits and financial resources for clients served within the Guardianship Program. This position ensures timely and accurate management of benefits, fiduciary accounts, court requirements, and representative payee responsibilities while maintaining strict compliance with legal, ethical, and regulatory standards.  

This role combines public benefits expertise, fiduciary financial management, court compliance, and client-centered case coordination to support vulnerable adults under guardianship.  

Core Responsibilities

Benefits Coordination & Eligibility Management

Manage public benefits for assigned guardianship clients, including Medicaid, SSI/SSDI, Medicare, SNAP, housing, and other assistance programs.  
Complete applications, recertifications, and renewals within required timelines.  
Monitor eligibility requirements, income/resource limits, and spend-down needs.  
Track and report changes in client income, assets, or living situations.  
Maintain knowledge of evolving benefits regulations and policies .  

Fiduciary & Representative Payee Duties

Serve as Representative Payee and/or Fiduciary on behalf of the agency for assigned clients.  
Ensure proper management of client funds in accordance with federal and state regulations.  
Maintain safeguards against commingling, misuse, or financial exploitation.  
Monitor account balances and implement spend-down strategies when necessary.  
Prevent and resolve benefit overpayments.  
Weigh the safety of client preferences to best honor self-determination.  

Financial Management & Accounting

Maintain accurate financial records for client trust accounts.  
Coordinate bill payment, budgeting, and disbursements.  
Reconcile accounts and monitor expenditures.  
Prepare monthly and annual financial accountings.  
Identify discrepancies, risks, or potential fraud concerns.  

Court & Documentation Compliance

Prepare and monitor deadlines for annual reports and financial accountings.  
Assist with court filings, fee applications, and required notarizations.  
Ensure documentation meets legal defensibility standards.  
Maintain accurate and timely case notes.  

Systems & Record Management

Maintain accurate data in case management systems.  
Upload and track supporting documentation.  
Maintain organized client records, financial files, and legal documentation.  

Collaboration & Communication

Provide recommendations to guardianship case managers regarding benefits and financial issues.  
Maintain relationships with government agencies, including Social Security and Medicaid offices.  
Communicate promptly with team members and external stakeholders.  

Meetings & Team Participation

Actively participate in Team, One-on-One, and All Staff meetings.  
Maintain availability via Teams or other communication platforms during work hours.  
Share updates related to benefits, clerks, court requirements, and regulatory changes.  
Bring cases forward for team consultation, problem-solving, or teachable moments.  

Ethics, Risk Management & Client Protection

Recognize and report abuse, neglect, or financial exploitation.  
Maintain strict confidentiality standards.  
Exercise sound professional judgment and ethical decision-making.  

Quality Assurance & Program Support

Participate in audits, quality assurance reviews, and compliance activities.  
Meet documentation and performance standards.  
Assist with program reporting and special projects as assigned.  

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in social work, human services, finance, or related field OR equivalent relevant experience.  
Experience with public benefits, fiduciary services, or financial case management preferred.  
Experience working with older adults or vulnerable populations strongly preferred.  

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Knowledge of public benefits programs and eligibility requirements.  
Strong financial management and accounting skills.  
High attention to detail and organizational ability.  
Ability to manage deadlines and complex compliance requirements.  
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.  
Proficiency with case management systems and standard office software.  

Certifications & Requirements

Demonstrated ability to obtain and maintain Texas Guardianship Certification within one year of hire.  
Completion of required fiduciary and benefits training.

Generous PTO policy  
403B contribution plan with employer matching  
Opportunities for working remotely with supervisor permission  
A collaborative culture with team building and staff events throughout the year

jobs.description:
Organization Summary

Civic Works Energy Programs makes it easy and affordable for Baltimore City and Central Maryland residents to make home energy improvements. As a “one stop shop” for a suite of home energy efficiency and rooftop solar installation programs, Civic Works helps homeowners and renters of all income levels maximize energy bill savings, while also improving the comfort and safety of the home.  As a social enterprise operating within Civic Works’ job training center, Civic Works Energy Programs is simultaneously able to provide transformative opportunities to unemployed/underemployed residents for on-the-job training and a pathway to a great job with family-sustaining wages and benefits.  

Since 2009, Civic Works has offered low-income energy efficiency upgrades to Baltimore and the surrounding regions. Since 2022, we have greatly increased our offerings of free and reduced-cost electrification upgrades, and many customers benefit from additional rooftop solar installations as well. Civic Works seeks an additional organized and detail-oriented program coordinator to collect, process, and compile weatherization project data and documentation, utilizing our Salesforce database and a variety of other cloud-based tools.  

Civic Works’ green initiatives have been highlighted by The Baltimore Sun, The Washington Post, the US Conference of Mayors, and the Maryland Sustainable Growth Commission. Join us in creating a resilient clean energy economy. Learn more about our transformative residential energy programs at https://civicworks.com .

Position Summary:

The Weatherization Program Coordinator will support Civic Works energy efficiency programs, specializing in tracking details for comprehensive energy audits and weatherization projects, electrification upgrades, and compiling grant reports.  The Weatherization Program Coordinator will be responsible for the accurate and timely updating of records in Salesforce, used for tracking open projects, open customer support issues, and open invoices. The Coordinator will also work backwards to ensure funder reporting and invoicing deadlines are met. The Coordinator will collaborate with both internal teams and subcontractors to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and customer satisfaction.

Primary Responsibilities:

I. Weatherization Project Tracking

Track open comprehensive energy audit and weatherization projects from start to finish in our Salesforce database.  
Run regular status reports on open projects in Salesforce, making accurate and timely updates to project records, and following up with coworkers and subcontractors when milestone deadlines are not met.
Support management in running monthly contractor check-in calls, including running bi-weekly status reports and keeping consistent communication with the contractors throughout the month.
Review audit and job submissions, ensuring they meet funding requirements. Ensure communication between the contractor and customer is being done in a timely manner and timely updates are given to the internal team via slack/salesforce.

II. Weatherization Grant Reporting and Customer Invoicing

Support a timely turnaround of project completion to the reimbursement of Civic Works for services rendered.  
Download supporting written and photo documentation, organize electronic files, enter key project data and household data into our Salesforce database, and follow up with co-workers and subcontractors when documentation requirements are not met.
Work closely with the Contracting Manager to prepare monthly accurate reports for grant funders.  

III. Program Coordination and Support

Provide backup support to the Energy Conservation Coordinator and intake team in processing updates to the schedule of home energy efficiency and solar appointments.  
Verify intake fields are complete in Salesforce, convert records from leads to clients, and assist in finalizing calendar events.
Evaluate protocols for continuous improvement and work closely with the Production Manager to adapt processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
Support the coordination on yearly contractor grant sub-agreements, including insurance and certification documents.

IV. Promotion & Marketing Support

Collaborate with Civic Works’ Marketing team on social media campaigns.
Collect and develop client testimonials for promotional content.

V. Customer Complaint & Issue Resolution

Serve as the primary point of contact for customer complaints, concerns, warranty requests, and maintenance issues, documenting and coordinating with internal staff, subcontractors, and vendors from intake through final resolution in a timely manner. 
Maintain detailed records of complaint investigations, corrective actions, and outcomes within Salesforce. 
Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements to enhance customer satisfaction and program performance. 

Qualifications
Education and Experience:

Prior experience with data entry is required.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace is required.
Experience with CRM software is required; Salesforce experience is preferred. 
Experience in an administrative or project support role is preferred.
Experience with programs that serve low-income clients is preferred.
Familiarity with the roofing or construction industries is a plus.

Skills and Abilities:

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Exceptional personal responsibility for meeting goals and a track record of success.
Excellent written communication skills, especially by email, text message, and mail.
Ability to intellectually engage with technical material and subject matter required.
Ability to prepare and submit accurate and reliable reports.
Ability to recognize problems, develop innovative solutions and implement them.
Strong initiative and ability to excel while working independently.
Ability to utilize electronic systems for all communications, correspondence, and documentation.
Commitment to advancing racial equity across systems related to job access, job quality, and the environment.
Commitment to working in and creating diverse, equitable, and inclusive environments.
Knowledge of energy efficiency, electrification, and weatherization is a plus.

Work Schedule and Location

Schedule: The position has a default work schedule aligned with standard business hours of approximately 7am - 3pm or 8am - 4pm, Monday through Friday, with reasonable flexibility to accommodate deadlines and personal needs.
Hybrid Work Policy: The position can apply to work from home up to two days per week, and would work at least 3 days per week from Civic Works’ office in Baltimore City. During the 90-day orientation period, additional in-office days will be required. This arrangement is subject to change based on organizational needs and may be adjusted to include additional in-person time.

Benefits

Eligible for benefits, including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision insurance, long-term and short-term disability, life insurance, 401(k) plan with employer match, and paid time off.

new_jobs.description:
Organization Summary

Civic Works Energy Programs makes it easy and affordable for Baltimore City and Central Maryland residents to make home energy improvements. As a “one stop shop” for a suite of home energy efficiency and rooftop solar installation programs, Civic Works helps homeowners and renters of all income levels maximize energy bill savings, while also improving the comfort and safety of the home.  As a social enterprise operating within Civic Works’ job training center, Civic Works Energy Programs is simultaneously able to provide transformative opportunities to unemployed/underemployed residents for on-the-job training and a pathway to a great job with family-sustaining wages and benefits.  

Since 2009, Civic Works has offered low-income energy efficiency upgrades to Baltimore and the surrounding regions. Since 2022, we have greatly increased our offerings of free and reduced-cost electrification upgrades, and many customers benefit from additional rooftop solar installations as well. Civic Works seeks an additional organized and detail-oriented program coordinator to collect, process, and compile weatherization project data and documentation, utilizing our Salesforce database and a variety of other cloud-based tools.  

Civic Works’ green initiatives have been highlighted by The Baltimore Sun, The Washington Post, the US Conference of Mayors, and the Maryland Sustainable Growth Commission. Join us in creating a resilient clean energy economy. Learn more about our transformative residential energy programs at https://civicworks.com .

Position Summary:

The Weatherization Program Coordinator will support Civic Works energy efficiency programs, specializing in tracking details for comprehensive energy audits and weatherization projects, electrification upgrades, and compiling grant reports.  The Weatherization Program Coordinator will be responsible for the accurate and timely updating of records in Salesforce, used for tracking open projects, open customer support issues, and open invoices. The Coordinator will also work backwards to ensure funder reporting and invoicing deadlines are met. The Coordinator will collaborate with both internal teams and subcontractors to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and customer satisfaction.

Primary Responsibilities:

I. Weatherization Project Tracking

Track open comprehensive energy audit and weatherization projects from start to finish in our Salesforce database.  
Run regular status reports on open projects in Salesforce, making accurate and timely updates to project records, and following up with coworkers and subcontractors when milestone deadlines are not met.
Support management in running monthly contractor check-in calls, including running bi-weekly status reports and keeping consistent communication with the contractors throughout the month.
Review audit and job submissions, ensuring they meet funding requirements. Ensure communication between the contractor and customer is being done in a timely manner and timely updates are given to the internal team via slack/salesforce.

II. Weatherization Grant Reporting and Customer Invoicing

Support a timely turnaround of project completion to the reimbursement of Civic Works for services rendered.  
Download supporting written and photo documentation, organize electronic files, enter key project data and household data into our Salesforce database, and follow up with co-workers and subcontractors when documentation requirements are not met.
Work closely with the Contracting Manager to prepare monthly accurate reports for grant funders.  

III. Program Coordination and Support

Provide backup support to the Energy Conservation Coordinator and intake team in processing updates to the schedule of home energy efficiency and solar appointments.  
Verify intake fields are complete in Salesforce, convert records from leads to clients, and assist in finalizing calendar events.
Evaluate protocols for continuous improvement and work closely with the Production Manager to adapt processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
Support the coordination on yearly contractor grant sub-agreements, including insurance and certification documents.

IV. Promotion & Marketing Support

Collaborate with Civic Works’ Marketing team on social media campaigns.
Collect and develop client testimonials for promotional content.

V. Customer Complaint & Issue Resolution

Serve as the primary point of contact for customer complaints, concerns, warranty requests, and maintenance issues, documenting and coordinating with internal staff, subcontractors, and vendors from intake through final resolution in a timely manner. 
Maintain detailed records of complaint investigations, corrective actions, and outcomes within Salesforce. 
Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements to enhance customer satisfaction and program performance. 

Qualifications
Education and Experience:

Prior experience with data entry is required.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace is required.
Experience with CRM software is required; Salesforce experience is preferred. 
Experience in an administrative or project support role is preferred.
Experience with programs that serve low-income clients is preferred.
Familiarity with the roofing or construction industries is a plus.

Skills and Abilities:

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Exceptional personal responsibility for meeting goals and a track record of success.
Excellent written communication skills, especially by email, text message, and mail.
Ability to intellectually engage with technical material and subject matter required.
Ability to prepare and submit accurate and reliable reports.
Ability to recognize problems, develop innovative solutions and implement them.
Strong initiative and ability to excel while working independently.
Ability to utilize electronic systems for all communications, correspondence, and documentation.
Commitment to advancing racial equity across systems related to job access, job quality, and the environment.
Commitment to working in and creating diverse, equitable, and inclusive environments.
Knowledge of energy efficiency, electrification, and weatherization is a plus.

Work Schedule and Location

Schedule: The position has a default work schedule aligned with standard business hours of approximately 7am - 3pm or 8am - 4pm, Monday through Friday, with reasonable flexibility to accommodate deadlines and personal needs.
Hybrid Work Policy: The position can apply to work from home up to two days per week, and would work at least 3 days per week from Civic Works’ office in Baltimore City. During the 90-day orientation period, additional in-office days will be required. This arrangement is subject to change based on organizational needs and may be adjusted to include additional in-person time.

Benefits
